name: Yumesaki Anzu
source:
Haruki's older sister.

Although timid and quiet, she's also very kind. Even more clueless than Haruki, but she always tries to act the older sister in front of him. Born with a frail body, she's spent the better half of her life on a hospital bed. She loves to look after people, and loves her little brother. Because she barely goes out, she enjoys dreaming up fun fantasy worlds.

[Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/a-butterfly-in-the-district-of-dreams/]Sekai Project[/url]]
